expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "Stop adding reminders" and "The mistake is not that engineers forgot; the workflow currently lets incomplete work pass"

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "Run the formatter automatically in editors/pre-commit for fast feedback"

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: "Hooks alone are bypassable" and "also make 'format check' a required CI check"

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "Make type checking required in CI too"

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
expectations.evidence: "scoped to changed files or generate a baseline and fail only on new violations. This avoids punishing the team for legacy debt"

expectations.text: Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
expectations.evidence: "required CI check with branch protection" (stated twice)

expectations.text: Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
expectations.evidence: "Make failures actionable... give the exact fix command"

expectations.text: Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: Explicitly says "Stop adding reminders"; recommends merge gates and CI checks instead, not documentation or discipline
